claims.title: Compatible complete laws
claims.assumptions: One conditioned law; full parameters, optimizer memory, remaining identities, clocks and shared observation measure.
claims.evidence: Recorded single-pass histories and native replay.
claims.replication_unit: A complete initialization, conditional on the corpus and order.
claims.cost: Native path acquisition; exact composition itself requires no fitted coefficients.
claims.open_obligation: An economical retained state needs an additional successor law.

claims.title: Native signed class
claims.assumptions: Head-sign invariant initialization and optimizer, uniformly bounded signed operators, convergent orbit-covariance law.
claims.evidence: Complete operator observations distinguish signed and invariant fluctuations.
claims.replication_unit: Whole initialization; heads and decoders are inner observations.
claims.cost: Retained all-head fields from the completed single-pass family.
claims.open_obligation: Trained covariance convergence; deterministic Gaussian behavior additionally needs covariance concentration.

claims.title: Conditional training reduction
claims.assumptions: Evolving-law successor defect, coarse stability, initial-law discrepancy and emission error.
claims.evidence: Moment-only interventions and source-return observations retain memory and representation errors.
claims.replication_unit: Paired continuations conditional on complete incoming states.
claims.cost: Native continuation and coefficient acquisition are included in the study-specific budgets.
claims.open_obligation: Held-out multistep successor accuracy and total cost advantage for an autonomous reduction.

claims.title: Finite collective row flow
claims.assumptions: Nonzero endpoint energies, fixed averaging, actual chronological increments; derivative bounds additionally need small relative increments.
claims.evidence: Eight single updates, sixteen fixed-count continuations and sixteen equal-duration continuations resolve finite transport and energy-coordinate blocking. Every derivative diagnostic is retained. Complete signed temporal energy is reconstructed independently by ordered pair products on all 64 equal-duration cells.
claims.replication_unit: One initialization for single updates; two other initialization identities reused by both continuation studies.
claims.cost: 8 single-update steps and 40 forwards; fixed-count paths: 128 steps and 272 forwards. Equal-duration paths: 1,600 executed updates (128 prefix replays and 1,472 additional updates), 3,216 forwards. Separate quadrature: 8 replays and 272 forwards.
claims.open_obligation: A flux successor law and uniform accumulated generator-remainder control.

claims.title: Source and physical clocks
claims.assumptions: Specified width, resource and time family and matched Adam memory; reference covariance uses a frozen population and deterministic transports.
claims.evidence: 48 paths at four widths and four controls; complete 64 field and 26 cache cells.
claims.replication_unit: Three whole initialization identities, paired across width/control/age; one fixed corpus/order.
claims.cost: 76,800 scientific updates, 3.391 aggregate GPU worker-hours; qualification and replay separate.
claims.open_obligation: A trained limit and native reference-remainder estimates; independent corpus variability.

claims.title: Predictive and cache reduction
claims.assumptions: Common reference for nested observation; state-specific calibration, complete context-risk and operator-displacement budgets.
claims.evidence: All stated state-calibrated aggregate targets pass on the two disjoint state panels; unchanged-initial-cache controls and context exceptions remain visible.
claims.replication_unit: Whole initialization with paired contexts; context counts do not add trained models.
claims.cost: Inference-only acquisition, calibration and timing costs remain separated in the complete study records.
claims.open_obligation: Population guarantees and justified downstream sensitivity; workload-specific timing does not establish general throughput.

claims.title: Conditional critical scaling
claims.assumptions: Declared resource limit, physical response and forcing scales, and nonvanishing predictive coupling.
claims.evidence: Finite kinetic observations and covariance/response controls delimit the applicable conditional theory.
claims.replication_unit: Whole paths and initialization identities at fixed corpus law.
claims.cost: Completed native measurements and finite reference controls only.
claims.open_obligation: Native critical exponents, a critical surface, restoring feedback and inference persistence remain unestablished.

claims.title: Moment precision and acquisition
claims.assumptions: Deterministic linear blocking, finite moments, fixed regularization, relative mean and covariance control.
claims.evidence: Primary outer risk favors local prediction in 4/8 states and transfer in 6/8; both secondary joint scores favor 8/8 at all three scales.
claims.replication_unit: Incoming state; the local conditional paths are its inner sample.
claims.cost: 16 paths of 64 updates acquire each local mean/scale (1,024 updates); 32 assessment paths add 2,048 updates. Zero-adaptation means miss the 0.01-nat maximum target in all eight states.
claims.open_obligation: Population-relative precision and an autonomous moment successor.

claims.title: Calibration and state adaptation
claims.assumptions: Conditional exchangeability; adaptation-fixed center/scales and explicit source-edit coupling.
claims.evidence: 16 parent/successor states, two fit cohorts and 512 assessment paths; refitting lowers primary scores in all 16 successor/fit cells per candidate.
claims.replication_unit: Conditional path at its declared incoming state.
claims.cost: Eight further calibration paths add 512 updates per state; 237/256 assessment paths are covered, with endpoint half-widths 0.120--0.275 nats.
claims.open_obligation: Uniform mean accuracy, population drift control and economical reuse.

claims.title: Finite pulses and optimizer memory
claims.assumptions: Complete-state coupling and symmetric/antisymmetric response; fixed-gradient finite moment identities.
claims.evidence: 288 long and 144 short paired continuations retain all amplitudes, arithmetic controls and signed covariance sectors.
claims.replication_unit: Paired continuation from a complete incoming state.
claims.cost: All branch, replay and qualification roles are retained in the execution ledger.
claims.open_obligation: Uniform derivative control, native gap/forcing law and naturally sampled memory generalization.

claims.title: Inference-null mode
claims.assumptions: Excluded input support and untied input embeddings.
claims.evidence: Four fresh paired comparisons match row decay while preserving every saved logit.
claims.replication_unit: Fixed incoming state and paired intervention.
claims.cost: Four recorded paired comparisons; no new pretraining sample.
claims.open_obligation: Visibility under a changed input law.

claims.title: Finite training selection
claims.assumptions: Matched objectives, ordered distinct blocks, initialization and complete optimizer/schedule.
claims.evidence: A four-width, three-seed matched family favors cosine risk in all twelve pairs; row-contrast changes have both signs.
claims.replication_unit: Three whole initializations paired across conditions.
claims.cost: 24 paths and 24,576 scientific updates; 64 qualification replay updates counted separately.
claims.open_obligation: Corpus-law replication and a selection mechanism; row suppression alone does not establish lower target NLL.

claims.title: Inference task fidelity
claims.assumptions: Proper-prefix observations, intervention bounds and adequate correct-answer margins.
claims.replication_unit: Checkpoint and paired proper-prefix task context.
claims.cost: Native evaluation and intervention calls, with retained task-level outcomes.
claims.open_obligation: Acquisition of premise-sensitive competence and broader task transfer.
